caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a standing human figure mounted on a rectangular wooden base. The figure is dressed in a long, green garment with a high neckline and long sleeves, decorated with evenly spaced small red dots. The cuffs of the sleeves are maroon in color, as is the hem of the garment. The figure has a light brown face, black hair, and a black beard, with facial features clearly delineated including eyebrows, eyes, nose, and mouth. The statue's left hand is closed with the thumb extended, while the right hand is held open with the palm facing upward. The wood grain and texture are visible in both the statue and its base. The background is a plain off-white color, and there are no additional objects or designs in the drawing.
title: Bulto
